historical_gap.tests_before_dataset: India played Tests from 1932. This dataset starts Dec 2001 — roughly 380+ earlier Tests missing.
historical_gap.odis_before_dataset: India played ODIs from 1974. This dataset starts mid-2002 for ODIs — roughly 500+ earlier ODIs missing.
historical_gap.t20_coverage: T20Is began in 2006; dataset is near-complete for T20Is aside from Afghanistan policy withholdings.

withheld.reason: Cricsheet policy: matches featuring Afghanistan men's team or Afghanistan Premier League are withheld.
withheld.impact: India vs Afghanistan internationals (and any APL-related) after the policy are not in this folder.
